comment: Every source this reading rests on, pinned. check.sh reads this file, clones what is
missing under the directory IOC_CLONES names (default $TMPDIR/ioc-clones) and resolves
every citation from the clone at the commit below, never from a live branch and never

private_repositories.comment: The private repository rows of claims.jsonl read: most with git, and a few its pull requests through the REST API. env.sh clones it under IOC_CLONES/agent-infra blobless, with no checkout, at exactly these commits, and then fetches the blobs under paths at each of them, every file those rows read, through the machine's git credential helper, which in a Legion pod answers for the repository's path. a0ccd32ea96b24555efe7fe54cc8ce8963835a07 is the head of pull request 3176 as read on 2026-11-19, which GitHub serves by its id. --replay reads the repository with git ls-remote before it builds anything, and a machine whose git cannot read it cannot run --replay.

python_environment.comment: The instant every package index read is held to: uv resolved the lock, the mas-lab constraints and the build constraints as the indexes stood then. landed.comment: A step of R12 that lands outside this pull request: cybermonklabs/legion#4636, from main, makes it, and merged to main as fcc746a38394a56aa9f3b7a49d91a2d0c8e0ad69, the squash of its head 8111f001f386abbcd67644dc55c9dab7e92973c1, so the step lives in skills/legion-worker/references/pr-body.md on main and not in this tree, which changes no skill file. The gate fetches that commit into a scratch git directory and names it IOC_MERGED_REPO; the proof reads the file there at that commit and holds each sentence published lists, so it exits 0 only when every sentence stands. A page's Proven by is a code span, which holds no backtick, so the proof takes the backticks out of the file with tr -d '\140' and greps each sentence as written, its backticks taken out; published holds each sentence whole, backticks and all. The record is this tree's reading of how a step landed this way satisfies c-landed-steps (verification.md version 4). The guard test of the step ran in #4636's CI at 8111f001, the job pi-legion / pi-legion, with success (https://github.com/cybermonklabs/legion/actions/runs/44760760061/job/136376541199); it is a run of the step, not its proof. check.sh --landed holds the page to name this commit and this command.

published.sentence: A `CHANGES` from either half is answered in the review: its findings are carried into a `REQUEST_CHANGES`, or each finding is recorded with why it does not stand.

Your `APPROVE` needs both halves run at the reviewed head, or both `Thermo` rows reading `not run` because the diff the round reads touches no runtime code (the whole change, or the difference from the last reviewed commit to the head).
